Power BI

Power BI supports interactive business intelligence, semantic models and operational reporting.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Connect a project dataset

Begin with the approved project dataset, calendar and reporting grain. In the intended Power BI preview, connect a project dataset; the visible result is a structured planning or reporting view with source fields visible. Review data ownership, dates, relationships and completeness before accepting or exporting it.

Build a decision dashboard

Use the selected measures, activities, resources or work items. In the intended Power BI preview, build a decision dashboard; the visible result is a decision view that exposes status, sequence and capacity. Review definitions, dependencies, resource limits and stale data before accepting or exporting it.

Publish a governed report

Start from the current baseline, progress cut-off and governance rules. In the intended Power BI preview, publish a governed report; the visible result is a reviewed forecast, report or delivery board with exceptions visible. Review variance, critical work, blockers and accountable ownership before accepting or exporting it.
